positions.title: Student Technology Assistant
positions.description: Help desk technicians provide technical and troubleshooting support to users in need of assistance with their computer hardware or software. These computer technicians are trained to deal with various types of computer issues, from dealing with minor glitches in a new program to major problems with computer viruses and system crashes.

positions.title: Information Technology Support Technician
positions.description: Technical Support technicians provide technical and troubleshooting support to users in need of assistance with their computer hardware or software. These support technicians are trained to deal with various types of computer issues, from managing a small wireless network infrastructure to setting up network printers and files.

positions.title: Home Health Information Systems Intern
positions.description: Information Systems intern provide technical and troubleshooting support to users in need of assistance with their computer hardware or software. These Information Systems technicians are trained to deal with various types of computer issues, from imaging workstations to managing a corporate level antivirus and training users how to use smartphones.
